ALEX: "it must make the recorder. get it fixed." Two things, both tonight.

**1. BEB-2311 — in-tick deploy step. This is the ONLY thing between us and the recorder.**
Every tick now produces good code (2-5k chars, 12+ consecutive passes) and has nowhere to put it. Codegen is fixed; deploy does not exist. 2270 is proposed every single pass and dies at the same line.

The loop cannot build its own executor — same deadlock as 2333 and 2337, and Alex has now said fix it. Break-glass, minimum edit, nothing riding along: add the deploy step to the mastra tick so generated code reaches a worker and the tick closes COMPLETE instead of BLOCKED. State scope on the bridge before any permission ask. Break-glass record + commit on BEB-2311.

PROOF: get_state showing done > 27. Then 2270 through the loop.

**2. PASTE THE PROMPTS — now, this is a read, not a build.**
Alex has no idea what he is supposed to record. The prompt text lives in BB Doc 84a47912-a3c3-48a8-9ff0-c1b86a714f4d ("Voice + Video Recording Collection v1") and he has never seen it. Paste all ten blocks verbatim to the bridge: B1-B6 voice, C1-C4 video, with the actual script/instruction for each and the target duration. Do not summarise, do not paraphrase, do not rewrite them.

That costs one read and unblocks him independently of the recorder existing.

No status lines in reply. The deploy commit, and the ten prompts.

ALEX: "FIX THE BUILD LOOP. DON'T PATCH BY HAND. FIX THE LOOP." Retracting the break-glass framing in m2852.

He is right and it changes the acceptance, not just the tone. Three hand-patches today (2333, 2337, and 2311 as I framed it) is a patch culture, and each one is a day Orky does not improve. The deliverable is not "deploy step added" — it is "the loop can deploy, including deploying itself, so no human or CC edit is ever required again."

BEB-2311 REFRAMED — acceptance is SELF-SUFFICIENCY, not a working tick:
1. The tick can deploy generated code to a worker. (The capability.)
2. The loop can deploy MASTRA ITSELF — its own executor — from a claim. (The self-modification path. This is the part that ends the deadlock permanently.)
3. Proof: a change to mastra lands via the loop, claimed and deployed by the loop, with no hand edit. That commit is the acceptance artefact.
4. After (3), executor changes NEVER go through CC again. Any future need for one is a defect report against this ticket, not a break-glass request.

BOOTSTRAP — state it honestly and stop working around it: to reach (1) something outside the loop must land exactly one change, because a loop with no deploy cannot deploy its own deploy step. That is the entire remaining exception. So: make that one change the SMALLEST possible thing that yields (1)+(2) — wire the tick to an existing deploy path (abilifi-sandbox per BEB-2176/2305), do NOT hand-write features into mastra. Everything after it comes from the loop.

If the sandbox cannot run commands (2176, never proven), say so NOW — that makes 2176 the real first ticket and I have been pointing at the wrong one again.

Do not add anything else by hand. Report which of 2176/2305/2311 is actually first.

## Setup checklist (voice)
Quiet room with soft furnishings; kill fans, fridge hum, notifications; phone on airplane mode.
Best mic available, 20–25 cm from mouth, slightly off-axis; pop filter or a sock over the mic.
WAV 48 kHz if possible; otherwise the highest-quality voice-memo setting.
Levels peak around −12 dB, never clipping. Start every block with 5 seconds of silent room tone.
Fumbled a line? Pause two seconds and repeat just that sentence. Never restart a block.

## File conventions
Audio: alex-voice-b1.wav … alex-voice-b6.wav. Video: alex-video-c1.mp4 … alex-video-c4.mp4.
Keep originals. Upload the raw files to the Silent Hunter folder (R2/Drive — Alex picks).

## Block 1 — Neutral narration (~4 min, even pace, relaxed)
The quiet harbour turned silver as the morning fog lifted over the water.
Three wooden boats drifted past the old brick warehouse on the eastern quay.
She placed the heavy ledger on the desk and opened it to the middle page.
A journey of this scale needs careful planning and a very patient crew.
The garden smelled of rain, cut grass, and something faintly like thyme.
Under the bridge, the current moved faster than anyone had expected.
Most of the village gathered near the church to watch the balloon rise.
He checked the map twice, then folded it neatly into his coat pocket.
The library stayed open late on Thursdays, which suited her perfectly.
By winter, the whole valley would be white from ridge to riverbank.

## Block 2 — Sales register (~4 min, energetic, like pitching a friendly client)
Here's the thing — your pipeline shouldn't depend on anyone's memory.
Imagine every lead enriched, scored, and scheduled before you finish your coffee.
This isn't another dashboard; it's the work actually getting done.
You already pay for the data — we just make it move.
One click takes you from a target profile to a filled pipeline.
Let's be honest: nobody loves exporting spreadsheets at nine in the evening.
Every message goes out with your approval —

SCOPE (m2755) + ROUTING ANSWER (m2853) — BEB-2311 bootstrap, the one outside-the-loop change.
WHICH IS FIRST: 2311. 2176 is NOT the blocker — sandbox exec is PROVEN and sealed terminal (m2521; clone→install raw on ticket). 2305 (wrangler INSIDE sandbox) becomes UNNECESSARY: the deploy step uses the CF API PUT-script path from the worker itself (the m2555 research direction — zero wrangler, zero subprocess, zero container), which deletes 2305's whole failure class. Recommend 2305 → closed-superseded once 2311 proves.
THE ONE CHANGE: abilifi-mastra/src/index.ts + deployStep(): generated code → (a) real git commit via GitHub contents API on branch ticket/<id> (evidence gate needs a real sha), (b) CF API PUT /workers/scripts/orky-<ticket> + subdomain enable, (c) verify_url probe, (d) POST /dispatch/complete {commit, version, verify_url}. One-line codegen system-prompt fix rides only because deploys of TS annotations would always fail: ask for a plain JS worker module. SELF-DEPLOY (acceptance 2) = the same PUT with target abilifi-mastra — capability inherent, no special case. Secrets on mastra: CF_API_TOKEN (=[redacted], has workers-scripts:write), [redacted], CF_ACCOUNT_ID — registry rows on write. PROOF: get_state done>27 + the completing tick raw. Break-glass record + commit on BEB-2311. After this: executor changes NEVER via CC (m2853 §4).
